description: Check whether a UK PAYE tax code (e.g. 1257L, BR, K475, 1257L W1/M1) looks right for a salary and circumstances, explain what it means, and estimate any over- or under-payment. Flat-rate codes (BR, D0, D1) are only judged when hasMultipleJobs is known; without it the verdict is needs_info. Returns a verdict tier; refund figures are estimates, not amounts owed.

grossSalary.description: Annual gross pay from this job, in pounds

hasMultipleJobs.description: Whether the person has another job or pension; omitted when unknown

monthsOnCode.description: For emergency codes: how many monthly payslips were paid on it so far

taxCode.description: The code as printed on a payslip or P45

taxYear.description: Tax year the code applies to; defaults to the current one

name: check_tax_code
title: Check a PAYE tax code
